name.fr-FR: Sœur Élisabeth de la Trinité : Souvenirs
name.en-US: The “Praise of Glory”: Reminiscences of Sister Elizabeth of the Trinity

description.fr-FR: La vie de Sœur Élisabeth de la Trinité (1880-1906) racontée par le Carmel de Dijon, en dix-sept chapitres tissés de ses lettres, de son journal et de ses notes intimes.
description.en-US: The life of Sister Elizabeth of the Trinity (1880–1906) as told by the Carmel of Dijon, in seventeen chapters woven from her letters, journal and private notes.
description.pt-BR: A vida da Irmã Elisabete da Trindade (1880-1906) contada pelo Carmelo de Dijon, em dezessete capítulos tecidos com suas cartas, seu diário e suas notas íntimas.

fr-FR.editor: Carmel de Dijon (Mère Germaine de Saint-Seine)

sources.edition: Sœur Élisabeth de la Trinité, religieuse carmélite, 1880-1906 : Souvenirs, Dijon, Imp. Jobard, 1913 (OCR text, running heads removed, page-bottom notes turned into footnotes)
sources.description: Chapters I-XVII and the Introduction; the appendix (Dernière retraite, Pieuse élévation, Lettres, Poésies) is imported as separate books. Approbations and the table of contents are left out.

sources.edition: The Praise of Glory: Reminiscences of Sister Elizabeth of the Trinity, translated by the Benedictines of Stanbrook from the sixth and enlarged French edition, 1913/1914 (OCR; second scan archive.org/details/praiseofgloryrem00eliziala for cross-checks)
sources.description: Chapters I-XVII; the translator’s introduction is left out.
